items.value:
Metal Pipe
Drop this heavy pipe on the floor and it'll fall with a mighty CRASH!
It's powerful enough to knock others away!

Hot Metal Pipe
Someone made this metal pipe extra toasty.
Not only will it knock others away when it lands,
it's so hot nobody can pass it while it's there!

Broken Metal Pipe
This pipe was tossed around a few too many times.
You can still throw it in the air, and it'll still come crashing down,
but it won't have nearly as much force as a normal pipe.

Bouncy Metal Pipe
A strange metal pipe coated in bouncy resin that makes it bounce over and over again,
pushing people away each time!
This sentient metal pipe likes to bounce around and launch others away with great force!
When dropped, launches nearby npcs away after a few seconds.
When dropped, launches nearby npcs away after a few seconds, and lays on the floor to block the path.
When dropped, launches nearby npcs away after a few seconds. Has less range and force than a normal pipe.
When dropped, launches nearby npcs away every few seconds, up to 6 times.
Mr Pipe's poster in the office.
